definition: הִתּוּךְ noun [masculine] a melting (Hophal-formative, dissimilated from הֻתּוּךְ , according to Ba NB § 102 d ); — construct כְּהִתּוּךָ כֶּסֶף בְּתוֺךְ כּוּר Ezek 22:22 like a melting of silver in a smelting-pot .

BDB5440 [H2046]

BDB5439 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB5441

הִתּוּךְ noun [masculine] a melting (Hophal-formative, dissimilated from הֻתּוּךְ, according to BaNB § 102 d); — construct כְּהִתּוּךָ כֶּסֶף בְּתוֺךְ כּוּר Ezek 22:22 like a melting of silver in a smelting-pot.
